description: This file defines the ControlBackend class, which implements the ControlBackendInterface for managing control operations within the Rialto client. It includes nested classes, manages application state changes, and interacts with external control interfaces.

classes.name: ControlBackend
classes.description: Final class implementing control backend functionalities, managing control client registration, application state monitoring, and synchronization.

classes.name: ControlClient
classes.description: Nested class implementing IControlClient to receive application state change notifications.

methods.name: ControlBackend
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control backend, creating control client, and registering it.

methods.name: removeControlBackend
methods.description: Method to reset the control interface, effectively removing the backend.

methods.name: waitForRunning
methods.description: Waits for the application state to become RUNNING, with a timeout of 1 second.

methods.name: onApplicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications, updating internal state and notifying waiting threads.
